source_url: http://www.pa.msu.edu/astro/MC2/accept/data/all_profiles.dat (retrieved via Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshot 20141022053622; the live MSU host is behind an Incapsula bot-wall and unreachable)
extraction: Raw upstream file, byte-for-byte unmodified. 2 header lines (column names, units) then whitespace-delimited rows, one per radial bin per cluster.
note: ACCEPT (Cavagnolo et al. 2009, ApJS 182, 12). Chandra ACIS archival sample, 242 distinct cluster names / 239 clusters. Contains ALL clusters, not only the seven targets. nelec = electron density from deprojection of the Chandra X-ray surface brightness profile under an assumption of SPHERICAL SYMMETRY (Cavagnolo+2009 Sect. 3.2; for clusters flagged 'a' in table1 a best-fit beta-model was used for the surface brightness instead). Tx = PROJECTED spectroscopic temperature measured in annuli and interpolated onto the finer density bins; it is NOT deprojected. Kitpl/Kflat and Pitpl/Pflat differ only in how Tx is extrapolated into the core (linear interpolation vs flat). Profiles run to the cluster centre - NO core excision. Mgrav is a HYDROSTATIC mass and is NOT an observation - see derived_assumes_newtonian_hse.

derived_columns_present.Mgrav/Merr: hydrostatic gravitating mass - assumes Newtonian hydrostatic equilibrium
derived_columns_present.Kitpl/Kflat/Kerr: entropy K = Tx * n_e^(-2/3), algebraic from n_e and Tx
derived_columns_present.Pitpl/Pflat/Perr: pressure P = n_e * Tx, algebraic from n_e and Tx
